title: MZI B short arm is cut: 0.5 um gap in the Si waveguide (route_b_short)
evidence: route_b_short (Y #12 opt2 (47.4,256.75) -> Y #13 opt3 (192.6,256.75)) is two Si rectangles [47.4,256.5,137.149,257.0] and [137.649,256.5,192.6,257.0]: no Si and no Si Slab between x=137.149 and 137.649 (0.500 um gap, full width). Walker (cuts every 50 nm, work/microscope/walk.py) loses the core at s=89.70 um and finds it again 0.50 um later; union of the route cell = 2 parts. rv.extraction() splits the arm into one-pin nets N8 [y#12.opt2] and N10 [y#13.opt3]; rv.lvs() reports net (y#12.opt2, y#13.opt3) design_only. Picture: work/microscope/gap_b_short.png
impact: Short arm of MZI B is open. Butt coupling across 0.5 um of oxide from a 500x220 nm wire loses roughly 6-8 dB (mode spreads, plus two Si/oxide reflections, which also make a weak Fabry-Perot); the two arms then carry very unequal power, so MZI B fringes lose most of their extinction and GC2->GC3 loses ~3+ dB. MZI B does not do its function.
fix: Close the gap: one continuous 500 nm Si rectangle from x=47.4 to 192.6 at y=256.75 (re-run LVS).

title: Confirm twins-2 (same as microscope-1): 0.5 um gap in MZI B short arm; loss estimate ~7 dB, not ~3 dB
evidence: Walker (work/microscope/walk.py, cut every 50 nm) loses the core at x=137.10 and finds it again at x=137.65 on y=256.75; union of route_b_short = 2 parts. Gap loss, my own estimate (work/microscope/gap_loss.py): local TE0 mode of the 500x220 strip (n_eff 2.440), transverse E launched into 0.5 um of oxide (n 1.444), angular-spectrum propagation incl. evanescent part, overlap with the mode at the far face, plus two Fresnel faces R=0.066: T=0.20, 7.0 dB (0.25 um gap would give 4.5 dB, 1 um 10.5 dB). The twins Gaussian estimate (~3 dB) assumes a wide 0.3 um waist; the 220 nm vertical confinement makes the beam spread fast.
impact: Arm field ratio ~0.45: MZI B peak transmission drops ~2.8 dB and extinction falls to ~8 dB; the two gap faces reflect ~6.6% each inside the interferometer. MZI B does not do its function.
fix: One continuous 0.5 um Si rectangle x 47.4..192.6, y 256.5..257.0.

title: Confirm twins-1: 5.000 um of MZI A short arm on Si Slab (90 nm) only, ~1.9 dB
evidence: Walker on net N11 (y#6.opt2 -> y#7.opt3): from s=11.40 to 16.35 um (x 58.774..63.774, y=2.75) the cut finds Si width 0.000 and Si Slab width 0.500; everywhere else on the arm Si 0.500. rv.tech(): Si Slab (2/0) is extruded 0..0.09 um (partial-etch slab), Si 0..0.22. rv.junction_loss(layer2="Si Slab") = 0.966 dB per face (T=0.80), two faces ~1.9 dB before propagation in the weak 500x90 nm strip.
impact: Field ratio between arms ~0.80: MZI A extinction limited to ~19 dB and peak transmission ~0.9 dB lower; >1 dB unplanned loss in one arm (critical by the intent). If 2/0 is not fabricated in the target run, this is a 5 um open (>10 dB).
fix: Draw the 5 um piece on Si (1/0); remove the Si Slab rectangle.

title: Confirm intent-1: walked arm lengths of MZI A give dL = 79.95 um (B: 60.35 um, in tolerance)
evidence: Walker centre-line lengths pin to pin (50 nm steps, recentred each step): MZI A long arm N12 225.15 um, short arm N11 145.20 um -> dL 79.95 um (analytic 225.144 - 145.200 = 79.944). MZI B long N9 205.55, short 145.20 (incl. the 0.5 um gap) -> 60.35 um (analytic 60.342), inside 60.0+-0.5. All 8 arm bends are circular R = 4.9996 um (circle fit of both edges, residual 0.5 nm, work/microscope/bends.py), so the bends are not the cause: the vertical straights of route_a_long are 34.264 um instead of 44.29 um.
impact: FSR ~7.2 nm instead of ~5.75 nm; MZI A does not give the specified response.
fix: Lengthen both vertical legs of route_a_long by 10.03 um (horizontal leg to y = -57.04).

title: Confirm intent-2 / twins-3: loopback input route centred 150 nm off the port axis at both ends
evidence: Joint cuts at +-30 nm either side of every pin (work/microscope/joints.py): GC4.opt1 device centre 0, route centre +150.0 nm; crossing opt2 device centre 0, route centre -150.0 nm (cut direction reversed) -> route centre y = 508.150 at both ends, ports at y = 508.000. Walker: side jump 150 nm at s=0.05 um. Independent full-vector overlap on my own 5 nm grid: 0.15 um -> T 0.676, 1.70 dB per joint (0.05 um would be 0.19 dB). The other 22 pin joints: offsets 0.0 nm, except route_b_in 5 nm.
impact: ~3.4 dB unplanned loss on the loopback GC4->GC5 (reference path), plus reflection at two steps.

title: Confirm twins-5: 2.00 um long, 0.250 um wide neck in route_a_out at x=265, y 19.02..21.02
evidence: Walker on net N5 (GC1 -> y#7.opt1): width 0.2500 um from s=368.85 to 370.80 (y 21.003..19.053), centred on x=265.000 (no side jump), abrupt steps both ends; 0.500 elsewhere. rv.junction_loss(width2=0.25) = 0.856 dB per step (T 0.82) -> ~1.7 dB. Picture work/microscope/pinch_a_out.png.
impact: ~1.7 dB unplanned loss on the MZI A output (Y #7 -> GC1), critical by the intent (>1 dB).
fix: Replace the 0.25 um rectangle by 0.5 um (x 264.75..265.25).

title: Confirm twins-4: route_a_in is 0.300 um wide over its full 32.6 um, abrupt steps at both ports
evidence: Walker on N4: width 0.3000 um for s 0.05..32.55, centre y = 0.000. Joint cuts: GC0 side 0.519 um (taper end), route 0.300; Y #6 side 0.500, route 0.300. rv.junction_loss(width2=0.3) = 0.052 dB per step -> ~0.10 dB plus extra sidewall scattering of a 300 nm strip.
impact: ~0.1-0.15 dB extra loss on the MZI A input; each step just above the 0.05 dB budget.

title: Confirm intent-5 / twins-6: the two route_b_out bends are circular R = 2.000 um; ~0.08 dB each
evidence: Vertex distances from the corner centres (260,256) and (260,381): outer edge 2.2497..2.2502 um, inner edge 1.7497..1.7505 um (35 vertices each) -> centre-line R 2.000 um, width 0.500. All 13 other bends on the chip: R 4.9996 um (fit residual 0.5 nm). My own local solve (work/microscope/bendloss.json): R=2 guided TE mode n_eff 2.449, k at solver noise; straight-to-bend overlap 0.991 -> 0.039 dB per face, 0.079 dB per bend (R=5: 0.006 dB per face). Note: the tool picks a spurious PML mode (n_eff 2.72, k 0.19) as mode 0 at R=2; choose the low-k TE mode.
impact: ~0.16 dB on the MZI B output path (0.13 dB more than R=5); rule violation.
fix: Use R = 5 um bends in route_b_out (room exists: vertical at x=262 can move to x=265).

title: Confirm twins-9 harmless: route_b_in 5.0 nm off axis at both ends, 0.004 dB
evidence: Joint cuts: GC2 and Y #12 sides centre 0.0 nm, route +5.0 / -5.0 nm (centre y 254.005). Overlap 0.0019 dB per joint.

title: Confirm intent-4 / twins-8 harmless: route_c_out s-bend 635.0 -> 635.1 is R ~5 um and on axis at GC5
evidence: s-bend polygon 10 vertices, 1.411 um long, 0.100 um offset -> two arcs of R 5.0 um, width 0.500 along the walk (N2), GC5 joint centre 0.0 nm on both sides. Mode-mismatch: R=5 straight-to-bend 0.006 dB per face, ~4x at the reversal -> < 0.04 dB total.
impact: < 0.04 dB; GC5 0.1 um off pitch only.
fix: Optional: put GC5 at y=635.0 and drop the s-bend.
